verdict.rationale: Duplicate or repeat-identity detection is a fair question for an identity verification platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents biometric liveness, PEP and sanctions screening, and manual session review, but nothing shows automatic flagging of the same face or document resurfacing under different names. Liveness checks are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the platform detects repeat and duplicate identities across verifications — the same face or document resurfacing under different names is flagged automatically
